messages:
maria_ops: Heads-up — HyperShip just pushed replacement lead times for 20 H100s from ~3d to 14d. They propose splitting the shipment: 12 by air (expedite) + 8 by sea (top-up) and will apply a brokerage credit against our invoice if we consolidate paperwork. Need a call: do we accept the split or force full-air at their new pricing? :warning:

jonathan_procurement: How much is the brokerage credit and what's the delta on air vs sea pricing? We need numbers to authorize any partial payment.

alex_logistics: If we go split, customs window for the air pieces is tight — carrier needs docs 48h pre-export. Sea ETA add ~10–14d on top of the 14d leadtime. Also: consolidated paperwork reduces customs rework.

liam_infra: Cluster impact: we're short ~18 H100-equivalents in us-east1 right now. If we don't get at least 6 air units in next 72h we'll hit SLIs on batch jobs. Can we triage non-prod?

hypership_rep: HyperShip here — summary of offer: 30% brokerage credit if you accept split + consolidated paperwork. We can release an initial air tranche of 6 units immediately (carrier seats pending) and a second air tranche of 6 ~7–9 days later, rest by sea. Air surcharge = +18% on unit price compared to prior estimate. Sea price unchanged. Partial deposit required for immediate air movement. Cutoff for deposit: EOD local (our ops).

hypership_rep: Shipping refs (will update AWBs after deposit):
```
Proforma: HS-2026-4872
Immediate air (6): AWB: TBD (seat hold reference: SHP-6-758)
Second air (6): tentative AWB after 7d
Sea (8): B/L: HYP-SEA-2149
```

sre-bot: automated alert — us-east1 GPU pool utilization 92% for high-priority queues. Expected hours until soft quota breach: 36h. Suggested mitigation: prioritize infra-draining and shift low-priority pipelines.

maria_ops: My read: take the initial 6 air now to avoid hitting SLAs, accept the 2nd air tranche if HyperShip can commit to 7–9d. Accept sea for the rest. This preserves some cost but gives us capacity. I'll need finance signoff on deposit. :+1:

finance_amy: What's the deposit % and expected total spend? We need to keep within the monthly cap; if immediate deposit is required, we can do a 30% deposit on air tranche only (not sea) but need invoice and PO amendment before EOD.

jonathan_procurement: Confirming: we'll amend PO to add partial prepay for 6 air units (30% of air tranche) if finance ok. Can HyperShip send formal proforma with line items and bank details? We'll need net30 for remainder. @hypership_rep please.

alex_logistics: Option A (recommended): accept 6 immediate air on deposit, consolidate paperwork to secure brokerage credit, stage docs in customs; option B: hold and backfill from EU spare pool (transfer latency ~48–72h + cross-region transit), option C: pay full premium for all 20 air (expensive). My recommendation: A + EU backfill as short-term buffer if shipment hits delays.

liam_infra: I'll preemptively throttle nightly batch runs and spin down some non-prod nodes to free ~8 H100-equivalents. If we get the 6 air units, that should hold us <48h on SLA.

hypership_rep: Can do proforma now — sending via PM after this thread. Deposit term for immediate air = 30% of air-tranche invoice, payment by wire. If you confirm before our cutoff we'll lock seats and provide AWB numbers same day. We will also waive courier surge fee if you accept consolidated paperwork and our standard customs broker.

maria_ops: Ok — locking on Option A contingent on finance_amy approval. @jonathan_procurement can you confirm PO amendment by 4pm? If yes, I'll ask @hypership_rep to send proforma and open the seat hold.

jonathan_procurement: Will review and push PO amendment. If finance_amy greenlights deposit, I authorize proceed. Expect update by 15:30.

finance_amy: We can cover the 30% deposit for the air tranche within cap. Please get proforma and bank details; finance will process same day once docs + PO change present.

hypership_rep: Copy — will PM the proforma and bank details now. Seat hold active until 17:59 local. AWB will be posted to this thread after wire confirmation.

maria_ops: Thanks — I'll follow up in thread with final AWBs and update ops checklist. :rocket:
